happy.title: You're glowing today!
happy.message: Happiness is contagious — share a kind word with someone around you!

happy.title: Ride the wave!
happy.message: Use this momentum to do one thing that helps future-you.

happy.title: Great energy!
happy.message: Celebrate by doing something that you like.

happy.title: Good vibes
happy.message: Take a moment to notice what made today feel good.

happy.title: Savor the moment
happy.message: Pause for a few seconds and really enjoy this feeling.

happy.title: Momentum boost
happy.message: This is a great time to start something new.

happy.title: Capture it
happy.message: Write down what made you happy today so you can remember it later.

sad.title: A song for you
sad.message: Sometimes music helps, try listening to 'Here Comes the Sun' by The Beatles.

sad.title: Take care of yourself
sad.message: A warm drink, a blanket, and your favourite show can do wonders right now.

sad.title: It's okay to feel sad
sad.message: Try writing down what's on your mind or reach out to someone.

sad.title: One step at a time
sad.message: You don’t need to fix everything today.

sad.title: Gentle distraction
sad.message: A familiar book or comfort video can help your mind rest.

sad.title: Be kind to yourself
sad.message: Feeling sad doesn’t mean you’re weak — it means you care.

angry.title: Take a breath
angry.message: Try the 4-7-8 technique: inhale 4s, hold 7s, exhale 8s. Repeat 3 times.

angry.title: Move it out
angry.message: A short 10-minute walk can significantly reduce anger and cortisol levels.

angry.title: Let it out on paper
angry.message: Write down what's frustrating you — no filter, just get it out.

angry.title: Strong emotion
angry.message: Anger often points to a boundary that was crossed.

angry.title: Release the tension
angry.message: Physical movement helps burn off excess energy.

angry.title: Pause first
angry.message: Give yourself a moment before reacting.

angry.title: Cool down
angry.message: Slow breathing can calm your nervous system.

fear.title: You're safe
fear.message: Ground yourself: name 5 things you can see, 4 you can touch, 3 you can hear.

fear.title: Courage isn't the absence of fear
fear.message: Take one small step forward — you don't have to tackle it all at once.

fear.title: Connection helps
fear.message: If possible, talk to someone you trust — even briefly.

fear.title: Breathe slowly
fear.message: Slow breaths tell your body it’s not in danger.

fear.title: Find direction
fear.message: Break the situation into small, manageable parts.

fear.title: Check the facts
fear.message: Fear grows when things are unclear — clarify one detail.

fear.title: You’ve handled this before
fear.message: Remember a time you were scared and still got through it.

disgust.title: Reset your space
disgust.message: Sometimes tidying up a small corner of your room can shift your mood.

disgust.title: Fresh air helps
disgust.message: Step outside for a few minutes — a change of scenery can reset your senses.

disgust.title: Channel it creatively
disgust.message: Strong feelings can be great fuel for drawing, writing, or making something.

disgust.title: Clean slate
disgust.message: Washing your hands or face can feel grounding.

disgust.title: Clear it away
disgust.message: Removing what bothers you can restore a sense of control.

disgust.title: Lighten the feeling
disgust.message: Discomfort passes faster when you shift focus.

disgust.title: Deep breath
disgust.message: Slow breathing can help settle your reaction.

surprise.title: Unexpected day?
surprise.message: Surprises keep life interesting, take a moment to process before reacting.

surprise.title: Write it down
surprise.message: Something caught you off guard today, journaling it can help you make sense of it.

surprise.title: Roll with it!
surprise.message: Adaptability is a superpower. You've handled surprises before and you'll handle this too.

surprise.title: Give it time
surprise.message: You don’t need an immediate reaction.

surprise.title: Shift perspective
surprise.message: Not all surprises are bad — just unfamiliar.

surprise.title: Process first
surprise.message: Let your thoughts settle before deciding anything.

surprise.title: Go with the flow
surprise.message: You can adapt — you’ve done it before.

neutral.title: Feeling balanced?
neutral.message: A calm mood is a great state for focused work or learning something new.

neutral.title: Clear mind
neutral.message: This is a great state for problem-solving or learning something new.

neutral.title: A quiet day is still a good day
neutral.message: Not every day needs to be intense. Rest and routine have real value.

neutral.title: Small goal
neutral.message: Pick one simple task and complete it.

neutral.title: Light planning
neutral.message: A bit of structure can bring clarity.

neutral.title: Steady state
neutral.message: Not feeling much is still a valid state.

neutral.title: Stable energy
neutral.message: Use this balance to recharge or prepare.
